notes: Android, Web/Wasm and iOS exhaust profile-follow relationships with strictly increasing id keysets in pages of 500 and resolve related profiles in batches of 100.

Independent review rejected two earlier Android snapshots: stale cache pages could be returned before refresh, and an off-window mutation could leave the observed first 1000 rows byte-identical and suppress the full reload. The accepted product uses NETWORK_ONLY for complete pages and permits one unchanged first-window emission after invalidation; ordinary observers keep their prior deduplication.

The common regression returns all 1205 ordered rows in 500/500/205 pages, covers an exact page boundary and rejects blank, repeated or unordered cursors. The Android gate regression models an off-window mutation whose first 1000 rows remain unchanged.

The first exact-SHA iOS compile exposed an invalid suspend function reference inside flatMap. The accepted Product SHA uses an explicit sequential loop, preserves batch order and propagates failures; exact-SHA iosX64 tests and compilation then passed.

No database schema, RLS, product semantics, credentials or remote rows were changed. The long-list and invalidation proofs are hermetic; they do not claim a production fixture containing 1205 relationships.
Previously accepted full interaction matrices were not repeated solely for the new SHA. Final GitHub jobs remain responsible for complete candidate recertification.
